_comment: Facts about the user's own copy of the game (no game content). tools/patch_nso.py and verify/structck.py read build_ids, rewrite_cntfrq, param_keys, host_calls and hooks; scripts/gen_game_config.py turns the rest into host/game_config.h. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Every value marked TBD is filled from Phase 0 evidence (PORT_ASSESSMENT.md), never guessed.
title: STEINS;GATE (remaster, Chinese release)
_title: display name used by the host and the app; the NACP title is recorded in PORT_ASSESSMENT.md after Phase 0
_ios_display_name: the name under the icon on the iPhone (user 2026-10-23); the installer kit's shell carries it (ios/run.sh build-shell), the development build takes PORT_TITLE from ios/local.env

inputs._inputs: SHA-256 of the user's own NSPs (measured 2026-10-19); scripts/extract_game.sh refuses other files

_modules: load order (Phase 0, 2026-10-19): main imports 34 movie:: symbols defined in subsdk0 (NintendoSDK_movie 20.5.17), so subsdk0 is loaded; rtld never
_build_ids: the update's ExeFS (scripts/extract_game.sh, cross-checked by scripts/xcheck_exefs.sh)
_app_pool: Switch application pool (3285 MiB); the host reports it plus headroom (references/04). npdm: no system resource (no virtual-address-memory mode), main thread stack 1 MiB, priority 44.

e9016a42a1b2bfa323bc987215c30af3._why: R1 F3.1: main+0x38b558 is the input system's set-touch-enabled(bool) (vtable 0x61a608 slot +0x20; flag at +0x300, constructor main+0x38b660, getter +0x38b5c8). Entry word ldrb w9,[x0,#0x300]; the gate reports x1 and changes nothing. game/sg_state.c registers the callback and dies if the gate is missing (that is the negative control).
obs: input system set-touch-enabled(bool), x1; R1 F3.1 (F3.0 measured which screens use it)

host._host: host/game_config.h values. Mac: Horizon-sized alias region. iOS (free Apple ID, no extended-VA entitlement): this game never maps the alias region (Mac 12-minute run: 'C5 alias: mapped now 0 MB, peak 0 MB') and sizes one heap as Total - Used (Mac: 'SetHeapSize: first heap 3152 MB'), so iOS takes mem_init's small-alias partition: one reservation of 256 MB gap + 512 MB alias + 256 MB stacks + the heap region, with the Mac's application pool (3797 MB; heap request 3761 MB). engage-port's 5-9 GB adaptive alias with a 256 MB heap ended this game at boot (iPhone 17 Pro 2026-10-20: SetHeapSize OOM req 0x6b000000 > cap 0x10000000).
host._romfs_marker: a small file every valid RomFS of this game has (Phase 0 listing: work/game/romfs-entries.tsv)

_default_lang: oe::GetDesiredLanguage when DM_LANG is unset: this is the Chinese release (NACP languages en-US, ja, zh-Hant, zh-Hans; RomFS has _sc / _tc / _en movie variants)

save_user._why: NACP user-account save data size / journal size (control.nacp +0x3080 / +0x3088): what fs::GetSaveDataSize reports
